name: Frostapple Orchard
tagline: Eighty heirloom apple varieties and a barrel cider room.
imageAlt: Ripe red apples hanging from a branch
description: Frostapple Orchard is a small apple orchard in Sebastopol, CA. It grows Heirloom apples, Pears, Quince, and Cider, with picking through autumn and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. It follows heirloom-preserving, wild-fermented cider, and bird-friendly practices. It has been growing since 1952. Check the website for current hours and availability.
